description: a and b are the same value: a tie everywhere.
reference: torch.autograd.grad(torch.minimum(a, b), (a, b), grad_out) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: The gradients follow graph-ir.md §3.1.11's convention here (checked by the generator): at a = b, g / 2 to a and g / 2 to b. b holds the same values as a: a test may feed one value to both, whose gradient is then grad_a + grad_b (gradients add up over every use, graph-ir.md §3.1.11). Expected values are PyTorch's (autograd) in f64 on the f32 tensors, rounded once to f32; PyTorch's own f32 result meets tolerance and gradient_tolerance (checked by the generator).
